name: Pate
summary: Pate is a Hải Phòng mark of its own, and it is also the fragrant filling inside bánh mì cay.
origin: Hai Phong. Named on 16 October 2025. The 2012 account uses it as the bánh mì filling.
howToEat: Inside bánh mì cay, on the 23 December 2012 account.
where: A street for pate on its own was not printed. Check on arrival. The bánh mì streets are on that sandwich.
